messages:
Priya (Docs): Quick heads-up — I'm opening a small PR to update SDK snippets and docs for the param rename: 'model' -> 'model_id'. Will also update the glossary entry and fix a couple of broken quickstart links. I'll post the PR link shortly.
Tom M.: Which repos are in scope? docs repo only or also sdk and quickstart samples?
Priya (Docs): Docs repo (docs/*), the SDK example snippets in js/python (under docs/examples), and the quickstart page. I plan to keep an alias in the SDK client for 2 releases so runtime won't break immediately.
Ryan (Eng): Thanks for the ping. @eng-runtime: we should be fine with the alias shim, just make sure the client sends model_id in telemetry payloads if available. No infra changes expected.
Jane L.: Small nit: glossary currently has an entry for "model" that conflates family vs identifier. I'll reword to "model identifier (model_id) — canonical id for a model version" and add a cross-ref to 'model family'. I'll also fix the 404 on the quickstart 'getting-started' link.
Priya (Docs): Sample replacement snippet I'll use in the py/js examples: ```python
# old
resp = client.generate(model="redwood-7b", prompt="Hello")
# new
resp = client.generate(model_id="redwood-7b", prompt="Hello")
``` ```javascript
// old
const r = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-7b', prompt: 'hi' })
// new
const r = await client.generate({ model_id: 'redwood-7b', prompt: 'hi' })
```
Tom M.: LGTM. Please add a short note in the PR describing the deprecation window and the client alias behavior, and add a unit test that verifies the alias mapping.
Priya (Docs): Will do. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — description includes checklist: snippets updated, glossary update, quickstart link fixes, changelog entry, unit test for alias. Please review when you get a sec. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Preview deploy available at https://deploy-preview-1234--docs.redwood.ai (checks passed)
Tom M.: reviewing now, should be quick. Thanks Priya!
Priya (Docs): thanks all — will merge after 2 approvals and then coordinate a short announcement in #docs and release notes.
